WITH n AS (SELECT 0 AS v UNION ALL SELECT v+1 FROM n WHERE v<255)
SELECT v AS code, CHAR(v) AS c, CONVERT(VARBINARY(1), CHAR(v)) AS raw,
       ASCII(CHAR(v)) AS ascii_code, UNICODE(CHAR(v)) AS unicode_code,
       DATALENGTH(CHAR(v)) AS byte_length FROM n ORDER BY v OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0)
SELECT CHAR(-1) AS negative,CHAR(0) AS zero,CHAR(255) AS maximum,CHAR(256) AS over_maximum,CHAR(NULL) AS null_code
SELECT CHAR(65.9) AS fractional,CHAR('66') AS numeric_text,CHAR('') AS empty_text
SELECT CHAR(@n) AS c, CONVERT(VARBINARY(1), CHAR(@n)) AS raw
